# Gentiana (Rookie Archaeologist)

Gentiana is the little slate-blue earth pony archaeologist with a cream-blonde ponytail, pinkish-red eyes, brown explorer jacket and saddlebags. She appears alongside Professor Fossil's excavation team at Rockhoof's old island village in Friendship is Magic. Think of her as the junior explorer among the grown-up archaeologists.

[![Hasbro / DHX Media — Shadow Play, Part 1; Gentiana at far right](https://derpicdn.net/img/2017/10/29/1572896/large.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/1572896)

- Naming: Gentiana is a [fandom name](https://twibooru.org/tags/gentiana); its original proposer and adoption date remain unverified. Rookie Archaeologist is her licensed Gameloft game name, introduced in [update 4.2 (March 2018)](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Update_4.2), not an established spoken television name.
- Appearances: [The foal index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) records her debut in Shadow Play - Part 1 (S7E25, 2017), around 12:06. No further television, film or comic appearance was verified. She is also a collectible character in the mobile game.
- Speaking status: No individual dialogue or voice actor was verified; the dig scene's speaking roles belong to Petunia Paleo, Professor Fossil and Applejack. Gentiana is a background participant.

[![Gameloft / Hasbro — 2018 Rookie Archaeologist in-game promotional card](https://derpicdn.net/img/2018/4/7/1701857/full.jpg)](https://derpibooru.org/images/1701857)

## Important moments

Both moments are from [Shadow Play - Part 1 (S7E25), episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=74213); exact video timestamps are unavailable.

- At Rockhoof's excavation — Gentiana joins the expedition where Petunia Paleo finds a Mighty Helm headpiece and Professor Fossil questions the legend of Rockhoof.
- A legend becomes believable — Applejack saves the excavation team from a rolling boulder, prompting the professor to reconsider Rockhoof's legendary strength and enabling the recovery of his shovel.

Research limits: these are two beats of one brief appearance, not independent character arcs. The images and indexed post metadata were verified, but Derpibooru blocked direct post-page access and some Fandom pages were available only via indexed excerpts.
